environment.description: Ktor service deployed on EKS with a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in TCP passthrough mode. No ingress controller authentication. Service is directly reachable on port 8080 from any pod in the cluster namespace. No network policies applied. Container runs as root with SYS_PTRACE capability for JNI debugging.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB, TCP mode, no TLS termination
